intro.paragraph1: Drone footage showcases a location in a way that is difficult to achieve with traditional photos or video. From the air, an entirely new perspective emerges that instantly creates a powerful visual impression.
intro.paragraph2: With FlyLens, you get high-quality 4K drone footage that is carefully captured and subtly refined for a professional look. The clips are short, impactful, and ready to use on social media, websites, or marketing campaigns.

about.title: About Flylens
about.subtitle: The pilot behind the lens
about.bio1: My name is Wout Wybo, founder of FlyLens and passionate about visual storytelling from the air. With a background in imaging and technology, I combine creativity with precision to capture locations in a unique way.
about.bio2: Based in Knokke-Heist, I work with drone footage to showcase businesses, buildings, and environments from a new perspective. Through smooth 4K drone shots, a visual impression emerges that is difficult to achieve with traditional photography or video.
about.bio3: My focus is on short, high-quality drone clips that are ready to use for social media, websites, and marketing. This way, businesses receive professional footage that presents their location in a strong and modern way.
